comments.content: [medium] `runCommand` re-implements the process execution and stream handling logic that already exists in the `run` method, which breaks DRY and adds maintenance overhead. Please factor the shared child process spawning, stream collection, and promise resolution into a private helper method that both functions use.
[medium] The rejection only carries stderr. Including both stdout and stderr in the error message would make debugging easier.
[low] A focused test that invokes both run and runCommand before setup() would document the expected failure mode and guard against regressions once the guard is added.
[low] Consider adding a timeout to the returned promise so a child process that never exits doesn't leave the awaiting test hanging indefinitely.
